description.value: Liquor For Less is a Fraser Valley discount liquor retail chain guaranteeing prices below government liquor stores, with six locations across Abbotsford and Langley. The Glenn Mountain location sits inside the Glenn Mountain Shopping Centre next to a Scotia Bank branch. Cyclists touring the Fraser Valley corridor will find a broad selection of beer, wine, and spirits available for purchase.
